# Step - not

`not` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps the traverser when the child traversal yields nothing.

## Forms

```text
not(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().not(__.out_e()).values("name").to_list()   // ["vadas", "lop", "ripple"]
```
